statement: Let R = T/a, T = F2⟨A⟩, a = (f1, . . . , fs) 26 be a finite presentation as a unital associative F2-algebra, where a denotes the two-sided ideal generated by the listed polynomials. If n ≥ 5, then Stn(R) has the following ordinary finite group presentation. The generators are gij(w), i ̸= j, w ∈ A∗ , |w| ≤ 2. To specify the relators, define a formal group word ξij(w) in these generators for every w ∈ A∗. For |w| ≤ 2, put ξij(w) = gij(w). For |w| > 2, write w = av, with a ∈ A its first letter, choose the least h ∈ {1, . . . , n} \ {i, j}, and put ξij(w) = [ξih(a), ξhj(v)]. This recursion terminates and gives a finite group word for each w. The defining relations are gij(w)2 = 1, |w| ≤ 2, (4.3) [gij(u), gkl(v)] = 1, |u|, |v| ≤ 2, j ̸= k, i ̸= l, (4.4) [gij(u), gjk(v)] = gik(uv), |u| + |v| ≤ 2, i, j, k pairwise distinct, (4.5) Y w∈Sft ξij(w) = 1, 1 ≤ t ≤ s, i ̸= j. (4.6) The product in Equation (4.6) is taken in the fixed order above, and an empty product is 1. The isomorphism to Stn(R) sends gij(w) to xij(w), where w is the image of w in R.
